title.en: An Act Appropriating Funds for Public Works
title.orig: An Act Amending Item (d) Group II, Paragraph (43), Subsection (f) of Section Two of Republic Act Numbered Fourteen Hundred Eleven, Entitled “An Act Appropriating Funds for Public Works”

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1957/ra_1781_1957.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Item (d), group II, paragraph (43) Quezon Province, subsection (f) of section two of Republic Act Numbered Fourteen hundred eleven is amended to read as follows:
"(d) Lavides Bridge, Atimonan Completion and construction of protection works for the approaches of the bridge and the adjacent landing P20,000.00."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1957
